card.name: Dash between bibliography entries
card.fires_on: A hyphen or dash that separates one reference entry from the next in a bibliography list. It comes right after a publisher, ISBN, or retrieval date and before the next author's name.

modes.label: After publisher or website
modes.description: The dash follows a publisher or site name at the end of a citation, before the next author.
modes.example: Waveland Press. <<->> Small M.L., Harding D.J.,

modes.label: After ISBN or page number
modes.description: The dash follows an ISBN or page reference and leads into the next entry.

card.plain: It marks the dash that splits one source from the next in a reference list, just before a new author name.
